text:
emma: Quick sync — webinar next Wed + pricing page experiment. Need final FAQ copy, tier names decision, and landing calculator placement. Who's owning what?

sanjay: I can take tier names. Proposed variants: "Starter / Scale / Enterprise" vs "Developer / Business / Platform". Leaning toward Dev/Business/Platform to make buyer intent clearer. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

lina: I'll own FAQ updates. Need the top 5 ticket themes and any legal phrasing. @maria can you pull support themes + recent CS snippets?

maria: On it. Pulling top ticket themes now — should have a list by EOD PST. Also +1 on gating webinar with a 1-min use-case checkbox so we can route inbound correctly.

derek: I can wire the inbound routing. Proposal: leads who select "Enterprise" or have >500 employees go to SDR enterprise queue, others go to PLG nurture. Need registration fields: interest_tier, company_size, primary_use_case.

analytics-bot: Experiment created: exp_pricing_2026_07 id=exp_9876
Tracking keys: pricing_calc_shown, faq_click, reg_source
Variant A: calculator top-of-fold
Variant B: calculator below fold

emma: Plan: run AB for 2 weeks. Primary metric = webinar_reg_rate (from pricing page) / calc_interaction. Secondary: demo_request_rate 30 days post. Also we need a short benchmark narrative for the webinar showing latency/cost vs hosted incumbents.

sanjay: For tier microcopy I'll draft 2 banner lines and 2 short descriptions per tier. Will post in #docs tomorrow for copy review. :memo:

lina: FAQ first draft will cover: 1) metering & billing cadence, 2) private deployments (VPC/on-prem options), 3) SLA & uptime, 4) overage rules, 5) free credits/credits expiry. Will link to relevant product docs.

maria: For the benchmark narrative, I'll assemble 2 workloads (chat bot, retrieval-heavy embeddings) and show cost/latency per 100k tokens. Want it included as 3 slides in the webinar.

emma: Yes — keep benchmark slides to 3 and put the deep-dive appendix in the follow-up email. Also we should surface the calculator in the confirmation email so attendees can preview cost modeling.

derek: Routing implementation note: I'll add webhook 
```
POST /lead-router/v1/pricing
{
  "interest_tier": "string",
  "company_size": "number",
  "region": "string",
  "lead_source": "string"
}
```
Will add 3 retries and DLQ on failure.

analytics-bot: Event spec posted: https://redwood.internal/experiments/exp_9876/spec (internal) — GTM tags: `exp=exp_9876`, `variant=A|B`, `calc_shown=true|false`.

sanjay: Quick q — do we want to test tier names server-side (URL param) or client-side only? Server-side lets us keep SEO clean.

emma: Server-side. Use `X-Exp` header for variant so preview links work for partners.

lina: Will coordinate with support for FAQ training notes and a short CS playbook for inbound questions.

maria: Sharing ticket themes in #support in 10m.

derek: I'll draft the webhook and routing doc in a PR and tag @sanjay for the enterprise path logic. ETA tomorrow morning.

emma: Great. Next check-in: Monday 10am PT. Please post any copy drafts + experiment heatmap before then. :thumbsup:
